## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- 与广告效果底表对账 (ads_expense vs expenditure_amt_local)
SELECT a.grass_region, a.grass_date, ads_exp_local_advertise, exp_amt_local_di
FROM (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, SUM(ads_expense) AS ads_exp_local_advertise
    FROM mp_paidads.dws_shop_performance_1d__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE'${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-1d')}'
    GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date
) a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, SUM(expenditure_amt_local) AS exp_amt_local_di
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE'${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-1d')}'
    GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date
) b
ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 数据对账 — ads_expense 与 expenditure_amt_local 差异

```sql
SELECT diff_cnt > 0
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS diff_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT a.grass_region, ads_exp_local_advertise - exp_amt_local_di AS diff
        FROM (
            SELECT grass_region, SUM(ads_expense) AS ads_exp_local_advertise
            FROM mp_paidads.dws_shop_performance_1d__reg_s0_live
            WHERE grass_date = DATE'${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-1d')}'
            GROUP BY grass_region
        ) a
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT grass_region, SUM(expenditure_amt_local) AS exp_amt_local_di
            FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live
            WHERE grass_date = DATE'${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME,'yyyy-MM-dd','-1d')}'
            GROUP BY grass_region
        ) b
        ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
    ) WHERE diff > 1
)
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

| 派生指标 | 公式 | 来源 |
|----------|------|------|
| take_rate_mtd | ads_expense_mtd / shop_total_gmv_mtd | 生产 INSERT SELECT |
| sku_with_ads_expense_ratio_mtd | sku_with_ads_expense_mtd / active_item_cnt | 生产 INSERT SELECT |
| ads_expense | COALESCE(expenditure_amt_local, 0) + COALESCE(display_ads_expense, 0) | shop_ads_performance CTE |
| display_ads_expense | SUM(ROUND(cpm_local * impression_cnt / 100000 / 1000, 2)) WHERE placement=9 AND slot_id IS NOT NULL | 展示广告计算逻辑 |

> 注: `take_rate_mtd` 和 `sku_with_ads_expense_ratio_mtd` 为比率字段，跨店铺聚合时需分子分母分别 SUM 后重新计算，不可直接 SUM。
